s1.text: Toy importers: Made in China won't cover a CPC.

s2.text: Say her CPC lists only the country. The catch?

s3.text: The rule wants month and year, plus factory name, address, email, phone.

s4.text: So she adds both before the next shipment.

s5.text: Free gap list? Comment M and Z, and we'll DM you the link.
